messages: Anya R: Quick design review request — compact streaming chat iteration. Focus: streaming text affordance, inline token counter, stop/regenerate wording, and keyboard/a11y behavior. Mockups: https://redwood.in/drive/playground-compact-v3.png Sam D: Nice — love the condensed rail. One main question: should Stop be a destructive action? feels heavy. Maybe label it "Interrupt"? Lucas P: From runtime POV "Interrupt" maps better to canceling the in-flight request vs "Stop" which sounds final. Also want to avoid two-step regen flow if possible. Maggie (A11y): A11y nits: token counter updating every chunk will spam screen readers. Use aria-live="polite" for counts but only announce when thresholds change (e.g., +50 tokens) or on completion. Also keyboard focus: the stop button must be reachable via single Tab and announce state (aria-pressed or aria-live message). Nate C: Implementation idea: keep token counter visually updating per chunk, but debounce SR announcements: announce after 800ms of inactivity or only on end. For keyboard: map Esc to "interrupt" shortcut; Shift+Enter to regenerate. Thoughts? Sam D: Esc for interrupt makes sense. For copy: "Interrupt" vs "Stop" — also consider "Pause generation"? Pause implies resume which we don't offer. So rule out "Pause". Anya R: Good call. Leaning to "Interrupt" (concise) and secondary control "Regenerate". Copy tweaks: token counter label should be short: "Tokens: 234" instead of long sentence. Tooltip explains token vs char. Maggie (A11y): Tooltip content: include that tokens are approximate and that not all tokens count toward billing (or link to docs). For SR announce: use role="status" region for final chunk: "Generation complete — 234 tokens". Lucas P: Performance note: debouncing SR announces means we need a small state machine on client to batch updates. Also ensure KV cache updates don't alter visible stream order. Nate C: CSS/HTML sketch: ``` Tokens: 0 ``` We'll add tabindex=0 where needed and manage announcements from JS. Sam D: Visual affordance: show a subtle pulsing dot during streaming, sticky to message bubble, and the token counter under the bubble in small caps. Also consider reduced-motion preference: stop pulsing for prefers-reduced-motion. Maggie (A11y): Confirm reduced-motion handling and color contrast for the token counter (need AA). Token counter font-size can be 12px but color must pass contrast. Anya R: Decision summary: label="Interrupt" (primary during stream), Regenerate as separate action, token counter visible small text: "Tokens: N". SR announces debounced (+threshold/end). Keyboard: Esc => Interrupt; Shift+Enter => Regenerate. Add tooltip with doc link. Action items: Sam update mocks, Nate implement keyboard & aria behavior, Lucas add batching/state hook, Maggie to QA with NVDA. design-bot: Follow-up created: DESIGN-4212 (update compact-playground mocks), ENGINE-9821 (keyboard/a11y implementation), RESEARCH-330 (a11y QA). :white_check_mark:
